bio: "Sushi meets Korean flavours" is the concept behind this centrally located restaurant near the pedestrianised zone. Expect expertly prepared nigiri and creative fusion sushi – the chef draws on experience gained at renowned locations such as Moriki in Baden-Baden, Feinkost Böhm in Stuttgart and the local restaurant named 5. The "Special Roll" is especially worth trying. The aesthetic is modern and minimalist, and from the counter you can watch the sushi master at work.
